# NFL Daily — 2026-08-23 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/23: Veteran RB Nick Chubb, a four-time Pro Bowler most recently with the Texans, announced his retirement from the NFL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49686432/running-back-nick-chubb-announces-retirement-nfl)
- 08/22: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. was fully cleared for 11-on-11 work after last year's torn ACL, setting up a QB1 competition with Tua Tagovailoa. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7529115/2026/08/22/michael-penix-jr-falcons-practice-injury-tua-tagovailoa/) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2091260451841610011), [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2091264011362807841)
- 08/22: Eagles RB Ja'Quinden Jackson was taken off the field by ambulance after an opening-kickoff injury against the Patriots; he was released from the hospital with full movement in his extremities and traveled home with the team. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49697364/eagles-jaquinden-jackson-taken-hospital-tackle-movement) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2091515614900769005)
- 08/22: Seahawks placed WR Jake Bobo on season-ending injured reserve with a serious knee injury and signed WR Julian Hicks to fill the roster spot. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49693366/seahawks-place-wr-bobo-season-ending-ir-re-sign-wr-hicks) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2091217523223994559)
- 08/22: Browns QB Deshaun Watson was booed in his first home game since tearing his Achilles in October 2024, calling the reaction "disrespectful," as Cleveland's QB competition with Shedeur Sanders and Dillon Gabriel nears a decision. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7531745/2026/08/22/browns-fans-deshaun-watson-booed-bills/)
- 08/23: Bills DT Ed Oliver is mourning the death of his 2-year-old son, who died June 28 after being found unresponsive in a family pool. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49693030/bills-star-dt-ed-oliver-mourning-tragic-death-son)
